column1: # Field batch: ui.VectorTextRenderer (19) + the confident part of ui.hud.GuiAssets (9).
#  * VectorTextRenderer - the constructor lines 19-120 show exactly what each buffer is for:
#    j/k come from ShaderProgram.a("a_position"/"a_color") (attribute handles) and l from
#    ShaderProgram.b("u_mvpMatrix") (uniform handle); d is "Gdx.app.getType() is Desktop or
#    WebGL", and it is what selects the float-vertex path (e/f/g/p are only allocated when it is
#    true); a/b/c and o are the short staging array, its count, its capacity and the GlBuffers
#    wrapping it; n is filled with an index table (34963 + glDrawElements) so it holds the index
#    buffers; m is the round-robin index into those buffers; h is the static Character -> float[]
#    stroke table the glyphs are drawn from; q/r/s are the cached colour (setColor stores the int
#    in q and the two short halves written per vertex in r and s).
#  * GuiAssets - the fonts keep the file they were loaded from (font_dokchampa_15, font_xirod_17,
#    font_dungeon_34/25, font_dungeon_15_outline); b is the lazily built locale default font and a
#    is the locale suffix it was built for; r is the 10-entry array indexed by faction id in
#    getFlagRegion; E is the AudioClip played by playClickSound.
# Rows left BLANK on purpose (keep the trailing tab, they stay 5-column): the GuiAssets button
# styles, check box styles and nine-patches are pure texture coordinates; their honest names come
# from the call sites and need a separate pass.
# Descriptors come from javap: do not edit them, the renamer matches on them.
# Columns: owner <TAB> kind <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> new
